This time, he recognized his daughter’s handwriting and began to cry.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘暂时停航的船。路灯把空荡的街道照成淡黄，便利店的玻璃映着店员困倦的脸。清洁车缓缓驶过，水声擦亮了路面。巷口有人揉面，蒸笼还未冒气，面粉已落满袖口。一只猫穿过斑马线，远处传来第一班货车的低鸣。天边仍暗着，生活却已悄悄翻身，准备醒来。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then opening that one the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you find a box with no smaller box inside."}
